name: Cognia Plugin Template Hybrid
description: Hybrid plugin template — a Python tool, a frontend tool that calls into that same Python backend, and a slash command. Replace this manifest with your own plugin's metadata.

permissionJustifications.python:execute: The backend half of this plugin runs in the desktop Python host.

browser.reason: The Python half runs in the desktop subprocess host.

mobile.reason: The Python half runs in the desktop subprocess host, which mobile does not have.

shoutEcho.title: Shout the echo
shoutEcho.description: Uppercase what the Python backend sends back.

commands.name: Template Word Count
commands.description: Count the words in the rest of the line, using the Python backend.

tools.name: template_echo
tools.description: Echo the supplied message back to the agent from the Python backend.

tools.name: template_word_count
tools.description: Count words in a string. Registered by the frontend half, computed by the Python half.
